name: Son of Sceva (1)
title: One of Sceva's seven sons
summary: One of the seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish high priest. The sons attempted to cast out evil spirits in Jesus' name without belonging to him, but were overpowered by a possessed man.

keyEvents.title: Overpowered by an evil spirit
keyEvents.description: Sceva's sons tried to invoke the name of Jesus over possessed people, but the evil spirit overwhelmed them so that they fled naked and wounded.
